title: Safe Deposit Boxes: the drilling notice and the earliest drilling date
content:
## Scope

This policy covers a Safe Deposit Boxes rental whose rent has stayed unpaid for a long period: when the drilling notice is sent and how, the drill pending status it starts, the earliest date on which the box may be drilled, and how the rental can return to active before drilling.

## Policy clause

1. When rent remains unpaid 120 days after the rent due date, the drilling notice is sent by certified mail to the address on file, and the rental becomes drill pending.
2. The box may be drilled only after 30 calendar days have passed since the drilling notice was mailed. The days are counted with the day after the notice mailing date as day 1, and drilling is allowed when the current date is on or after the notice mailing date plus 30 calendar days. The notice mailing date is taken from the bank's record of that rental.
3. Paying everything due before the drilling date returns the rental to active.

## Values by box size

| Official box size | Notice sent when rent is unpaid this long after the due date | Calendar days from notice to earliest drilling | How the notice is sent |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3x5 Safe Deposit Box | 120 days | 30 | Certified mail |
| 3x10 Safe Deposit Box | 120 days | 30 | Certified mail |
| 5x10 Safe Deposit Box | 120 days | 30 | Certified mail |
| 10x10 Safe Deposit Box | 120 days | 30 | Certified mail |
| 10x15 Safe Deposit Box | 120 days | 30 | Certified mail |
| 10x20 Safe Deposit Box | 120 days | 30 | Certified mail |

## Earliest drilling date: boundary cases

Hypothetical drilling notice mailed on 10 June.

| Current date | Day of the notice count | May the box be drilled? |
|---|---|---|
| 11 June | Day 1 | No |
| 9 July | Day 29 | No |
| 10 July | Day 30, the notice date plus 30 calendar days | Yes |
| 11 July | Day 31 | Yes |

## Sequence in brief

Rent unpaid 120 days after the due date → drilling notice sent by certified mail to the address on file → rental drill pending → the notice period of 30 calendar days runs → drilling allowed from the notice date plus 30 calendar days.

At any point before the drilling date, paying everything due returns the rental to active.

## Basis Q&A

**Can the box be drilled on the day the notice period ends?** Yes. Drilling is allowed on or after the notice mailing date plus 30 calendar days, so the boundary day is included.

**Where is the drilling notice sent?** To the address on file, by certified mail.

**The lessee pays everything due after receiving the notice. What happens?** If the payment comes before the drilling date, the rental returns to active.
